# Skill: daisyui-ux

# Resources
- [DaisyUI](https://daisyui.com/)
- 

## Constraints
- Elements: Use native DaisyUI component classes (`btn`, `card`, `modal`, `alert`, `input`). Do not rebuild layouts from scratch with Tailwind.
- Theming: Use semantic color tokens only (`btn-primary`, `bg-base-100`, `text-content`) to support dark/light modes out of the box.
- HTML: Strict semantic tags (`<main>`, `<section>`, `<nav>`).
